page.notes: The asterisk-like mark before "sentimus" is doubtful and may be a printed reference or quotation mark. "quaq;" is read as printed; the letter before "q;" is doubtful. The large "L" before "Acus" is a decorative section initial, not part of the word. The page numbers in the right column are printed as numerals with underlining and blue highlighting, which is not reproduced. "507" and "505" differ slightly in print and "505" is the reading taken. Long s read as plain s throughout. Reading of "illasa" (possibly illæsa) is doubtful; "Lotio" is the catchword. Blue underlined numbers in the index are printed reference marks, copied as plain figures.
